title: Interface: an event
question: This repository emits the USER_GREETED webhook event. Which other repositories react to it, and what do they do? Give repo/file:line.
answer_key:
Only mail-app: mail-app/src/webhooks.ts line 10 registers sendWelcomeMail for USER_GREETED; sendWelcomeMail (mail-app/src/mail.ts line 1) logs a welcome message.
Traps: web-app/src/analytics.ts registers a handler for PAGE_VIEWED and mail-app/src/digest.ts for DAILY_DIGEST — different events; they do not react to USER_GREETED.
Scoring: correct = mail-app webhooks.ts with sendWelcomeMail, stated as the only reaction. partial = mail-app named without the handler, or other registrations left as possible. wrong = a trap file named as reacting, or nothing found.
lesson: Events are contracts: only the contract graph links the emitter to the handler of THIS event; the code graphs only see three onEvent registrations.
plain: The API team emits a USER_GREETED event. Which other repos react to it, and how? (Three files register event handlers; only one handles USER_GREETED.)
